characterInteraction.description: The Host introduces Wade to the audience. Wade interacts with the host and the audience by smiling at them. The audience claps and laughs.

narrativeProgression.description: The host calls Wade onto the stage to give his speech.
Wade gets on stage to give his speech.

characterInteraction.description: Wade delivers his speech to the audience, who is attentively listening.

narrativeProgression.description: Wade begins by thanking the audience for the invitation to speak and introduces himself as Wade Desper Cray running for the City Council seat in Valdosta.
He mentions his upbringing, growing up less fortunate and in poverty.
He states his gratefulness for the opportunities that his faith has provided him.

characterInteraction.description: Wade interacts with the audience by sharing his goals for the city if elected as a council member. The audience continues to listen attentively.

narrativeProgression.description: Wade shares his motivations for running for City Council. He believes their city is great and desires to build relationships between citizens and the government, particularly focusing on collaboration with Chief Brian Childish and his staff for city growth.
He aims to bring a transit system to Valdosta to address city transit needs.

He plans to advocate for the youth, having observed the various difficulties children face. He believes in positive activities for youth in Valdosta and seeks to support and motivate children towards becoming productive citizens.

He desires to be part of building better jobs for the city, ensuring opportunities for everyone wanting to improve. Wade wants to be a voice in the city, contributing to city government in helping this happen.
He briefly mentions his family and his successful childcare center, highlighting his understanding of taxes and payrolls.

scenes.thematicElements: Community Involvement, Youth Development, Economic Growth
scenes.title: Wade's Vision and Objectives

characterInteraction.description: Wade continues to interact with the audience by sharing his future vision for the city. The audience is attentive and shows their appreciation with applause.

narrativeProgression.description: He shares his slogan, 'Take action, get results', advocating for individual action and involvement for positive change.
He stresses the need for everyone to take action and get involved for positive change, urging everyone to vote and become part of this process.
He plans to be a voice for District 1, aiming to be present, provide representation, and protect the future of their community.

Wade expresses gratitude for his role as a pastor of one of the city's great churches for 29 years. He states his plan, if elected to City Council District 1, to be present for the city, ensure representation for every citizen, and protect their community's future.
He ends by expressing gratitude to the Democratic Party for the invitation to speak.

climax.description: He ends by expressing gratitude to the Democratic Party for the invitation to speak.
